hypotheses.M0_family_advantage_survives_data_matchi: Same-family routes exceed the within-pair median of equal-data outside-family routes by at least 0.03 median target projection on both corpora.
hypotheses.M1_family_route_wins_most_pairs: Same-family routes beat the equal-data outside median on at least 70% of lexical pairs on both corpora.
hypotheses.M2_family_route_is_head_specific: Same-family routes beat their median cyclic-head-shift control by at least 1.5x on both corpora.
hypotheses.M3_advantage_is_not_one_family: At least three of five semantic families have positive median family advantage on both corpora.
